text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Duramente ran splendidly. 
But her expression was clouded. 
She had not managed to run while holding herself back.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
She says she wants to win the Classic races with a run 
she herself can call the strongest. 
Then it is a trainer's job to work out how.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
So I asked Air Groove, who knows her well, for her thoughts. 
Air Groove told me about something 
from when they were children.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Long ago, when Duramente got carried away, 
her father called her name in a loud voice. 
She regained her composure, and won.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
--Let us try the same method. 
I will get my voice through to Duramente, whatever it takes. 
At the next race, the Satsuki Sho.
